snippet.title: Dungeon CRUSH – fight by drawing links | pixel-art roguelite
snippet.description:
Drag links through swords, shields, potions and mana. The board refills from a bag of tiles you build, so every run plays differently.
Act I is free; one purchase opens the rest. No ads, no account, plays offline.
Out now on Android. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dungeoncrush.game
#roguelite #pixelart #indiedev #androidgaming #indiegames
